## Feature summary
A clear and concise description of what the feature or improvement is.

## Problem statement / Motivation
Is this related to a specific genre, PDF structure, TTS model, or output format? Explain why this would be useful.

## Proposed solution
Describe how you envision the feature working, including any CLI flags, manifest schema changes, or pipeline stages.

## Alternative approaches considered
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Additional context
Add any other context, references, or sample PDFs/manifests here.
